:::: {.main-research-content}

I am a plant scientist working on **disease resistance in lettuce**, with a focus on
how the crop responds to necrotrophic fungal pathogens at the transcriptional level.
I am a PhD researcher at the University of York.

My current work combines time-series transcriptomics, reference transcriptome
construction and CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing to identify and test candidate regulators
of resistance — reading that response at the level of individual transcripts rather
than whole genes. Before moving into plant pathology and molecular biology, I worked
in seed science on the longevity, storage and priming of vegetable seed.

## research

**Plant–pathogen interactions.** How lettuce (*Lactuca sativa*) defends itself against
necrotrophic fungi such as *Botrytis cinerea* and *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*, and which
regulators of that response could be useful in breeding for resistance.

**Transcriptomics.** Building transcript-level resources for lettuce, including
[LsRTDv1](research/index.qmd), a reference transcript dataset that makes accurate
transcript-specific expression analysis possible in this crop.

**Genome editing.** Applying CRISPR-Cas9 approaches to functionally test candidate
resistance genes in lettuce.

**Seed science.** Earlier work on seed longevity, storage and priming in lettuce,
onion and cabbage.

## selected publication

Kara, M.F., Guo, W., Zhang, R. and Denby, K. (2024). LsRTDv1, a reference transcript
dataset for accurate transcript-specific expression analysis in lettuce.
*The Plant Journal*, 120(1), 370–386.
DOI: [10.1111/tpj.16978](https://doi.org/10.1111/tpj.16978) PMID: [39145419](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39145419/)

[See all publications →](research/index.qmd)

```{=html}
<form class="contact-form" id="contact-form"
      action="https://formspree.io/f/mgawdaja"
      method="POST">
	<input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="Message from mfkara.net">
	<!-- Honeypot: bots fill this, humans never see it. -->
	<input type="text" name="_gotcha" class="contact-form__hp" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true">

	<div class="contact-form__row">
		<label class="contact-form__field">
			<span class="contact-form__label">Name</span>
			<input type="text" name="name" required autocomplete="name">
		</label>
		<label class="contact-form__field">
			<span class="contact-form__label">Email</span>
			<input type="email" name="email" required autocomplete="email">
		</label>
	</div>

	<label class="contact-form__field">
		<span class="contact-form__label">Message</span>
		<textarea name="message" rows="6" required></textarea>
	</label>

	<!-- Turnstile renders here. It must stay INSIDE the form so the hidden
	     cf-turnstile-response input is picked up by new FormData(form). -->
	<div class="contact-form__captcha" id="cf-turnstile-container"></div>

	<button type="submit" class="contact-form__submit">Send message</button>
	<p class="contact-form__status" id="contact-form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>

<script>
(function () {
	var form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
	var status = document.getElementById('contact-form-status');
	if (!form) return;

	var TURNSTILE_SITEKEY = '0x4AAAAAAEW51OgynN_DlzDk';
	var widgetId = null;

	// The site has a light/dark toggle. Turnstile's own theme:'auto' follows the
	// OS, not this site's toggle, so the theme is derived from --af-bg instead
	// and the widget is re-rendered when the visitor flips the scheme.
	function currentTheme() {
		var bg = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
			.getPropertyValue('--af-bg').trim().toLowerCase();
		return bg === '#ffffff' || bg === '#fff' ? 'light' : 'dark';
	}

	function renderWidget() {
		if (!window.turnstile) return;
		var container = document.getElementById('cf-turnstile-container');
		if (!container) return;
		if (widgetId !== null) { window.turnstile.remove(widgetId); widgetId = null; }
		widgetId = window.turnstile.render(container, {
			sitekey: TURNSTILE_SITEKEY,
			action: 'contact',
			theme: currentTheme()
		});
	}

	// Explicit render (rather than the implicit .cf-turnstile scan) because we
	// need the widget ID: tokens are single-use, so the widget must be reset
	// after each attempt or a retry submits a stale, already-redeemed token.
	window.cfTurnstileOnLoad = renderWidget;

	var toggle = document.querySelector('.quarto-color-scheme-toggle');
	if (toggle) {
		toggle.addEventListener('click', function () { setTimeout(renderWidget, 250); });
	}

	// Progressive enhancement: the <form> carries a real action + method="POST",
	// so if this script fails to run the browser performs a normal Formspree
	// submission (the "Basic HTML" integration) instead of doing nothing.
	form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
		event.preventDefault();

		var button = form.querySelector('.contact-form__submit');

		// Gate, don't replace: the existing handler is unchanged, it just does
		// not run until a Turnstile token exists.
		var token = window.turnstile && widgetId !== null
			? window.turnstile.getResponse(widgetId)
			: null;
		if (window.turnstile && !token) {
			status.textContent = 'Please complete the verification check before sending.';
			status.className = 'contact-form__status is-error';
			return;
		}

		button.disabled = true;
		status.textContent = 'Sending…';
		status.className = 'contact-form__status';

		fetch(form.action, {
			method: 'POST',
			body: new FormData(form),
			headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }
		}).then(function (response) {
			if (response.ok) {
				form.reset();
				status.textContent = 'Thanks — your message has been sent.';
				status.className = 'contact-form__status is-ok';
			} else {
				return response.json().then(function (data) {
					throw new Error((data.errors || []).map(function (e) { return e.message; }).join(', ') || 'Submission failed');
				});
			}
		}).catch(function (error) {
			// Deliberately no email address here — the whole point of the form is
			// that the address is never published on the page.
			status.textContent = 'Sorry, that did not send (' + error.message + '). Please try again, or reach me through one of the profile links above.';
			status.className = 'contact-form__status is-error';
		}).then(function () {
			button.disabled = false;
			// Single-use token: redeemed at siteverify, so clear it either way.
			if (window.turnstile && widgetId !== null) window.turnstile.reset(widgetId);
		});
	});
})();
</script>
<script src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?onload=cfTurnstileOnLoad&render=explicit" async defer></script>
```
